title: Find out what anything is with What's This
done: That is it: press the question mark, or ⌥⌘? (⇧F1 on Ubuntu), whenever you meet something you do not know.

steps.caption: The question mark at the right of the header asks what anything in the window is.
Press it, and the pointer becomes a question. Pointing at something outlines it and shows its name.
Click Hold, here: instead of holding the agent, a card says what Hold is for, and lists the lessons that teach it.
Play a lesson from the card, or click elsewhere to close it. One click asks one question; hold Shift to keep asking.
Your turn: press the question mark, then click anything you like.
